response.overview: Putri, a fresh graduate going through her first job interview, feels overwhelmed by the pressure to succeed and the fear of failing. Before entering the interview room, she sprays a calming perfume given to her by a close friend. When two seemingly serious HR interviewers start asking her strange questions, Putri becomes increasingly nervous. But she soon discovers that they are simply curious about the perfume’s comforting scent. As she shares the fragrance with them, it takes the interviewers to peaceful places and turning an anxious interview into an unexpectedly calming experience.
response.tagline: A story in every scent, a memory in every moment.
response.title: Jalanin Aja Dulu
